message.content:
This is granite slabs, polished on top and simply cut. The relevant heading is 6802, which covers worked monumental or building stone. Heading 6802.93 covers granite, other than tiles, cubes and similar articles: 6802.93.00 with statistical suffixes.

The subheadings under 6802.93 are:
- 6802.93.00.10: Slabs
- 6802.93.00.90: Other

Heading 6802 applies because the stone is polished, which is worked beyond simply cut or sawn. Heading 2516 covers granite merely cut into rectangular blocks or slabs, but polishing excludes it. Under 6802.93, I recall the current schedule as 6802.93.0010 for "Slabs" and 6802.93.0090 for other. Within 6802.93 there are also subdivisions by value: 6802.93.00 has "Not over 7 cm thick" in some versions. I'm not certain which version applies, so I'll go with the version I recall best.

Based on this, I classify the merchandise as 6802.93.0090 (granite, worked, other than tiles), though the slab line is a possible alternative. The slabs are 0.75 to 1.5 inches thick, which is under 7 cm. In the schedule, I believe the 6802.93.00 lines are: 10 "Slabs" and 90 "Other". So the slab suffix fits best.
